central_topic: Whether a single run of a budget-limited stochastic Kernel SHAP explainer gives a reliable top-k feature attribution for a trained tabular model, and whether per-instance reliability can be predicted from that one run via a delete-one-group jackknife with budget-prior shrinkage. Post-draft pass fills only the citation gaps for the instability comparators, the jackknife and shrinkage ingredients, and the deployment claim.

queries.query: stability of LIME explanations repeated runs random perturbation sampling instability index
queries.rationale: Gap 'related-work-instability-comparators' (high): Related Work cites only generic robustness and disagreement papers. Closest comparators measure repeatability of LIME-style sampled explainers across reruns. Existing Alvarez-Melis, Krishna and Yuan entries are not repeat-run LIME stability studies, so this is not a duplicate.

queries.query: confidence intervals standard errors for Kernel SHAP sampled Shapley estimates per instance uncertainty
queries.rationale: Gap 'related-work-instability-comparators' (high): the novelty claim 'a statement about the run rather than the estimator's average error' needs per-instance sampling-uncertainty work for SHAP-style estimators as the direct comparator. The bibliography has only population-level inference (Williamson2020Efficient) and worst-case guarantees (Musco2024Provably, Covert2020Improving).

Gap 'method-jackknife-shrinkage-rationale' (medium): the Method section uses a 'delete-one-group jackknife covariance' with no cited statistical source. One or two foundational references (e.g. grouped or delete-d jackknife) ground the terminology.

queries.query: empirical Bayes shrinkage estimation toward a prior
queries.rationale: Gap 'method-jackknife-shrinkage-rationale' (medium): the draft describes shrinking the simulated value toward a budget-specific prior as 'empirical-Bayes-style' without a source. A foundational empirical Bayes or James-Stein shrinkage reference supports the term.

queries.query: explainable machine learning in deployment how practitioners use feature attributions
queries.rationale: Gap 'intro-deployment-claim' (low): the opening claim about Shapley attributions justifying predictions in credit and medical settings, and the run-once practice, is backed only by Lundberg2017Unified. One empirical deployment or practitioner study would support it. This is the lowest priority and can be dropped if retrieval is noisy.
